wiki.title: Billy Bob Faulkingham
wiki.extract: William Robert Faulkingham is an American politician and lobsterman who has served in the Maine House of Representatives from the 12th district since 2022. A Republican, Faulkingham served in the U.S. Marines. He is the Minority Leader of the lower house. He previously served in the 136th district from 2018 to 2022.
